texts.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
texts.en:
Scans of [from.Planet.GetName] revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once committed to its construction. An archaeological expedition will help us ascertain how it ended up here.

sections.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
sections.en:
Scans of [from.Planet.GetName] revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once committed to its construction. An archaeological expedition will help us ascertain how it ended up here.

texts.zh: 对[from.Planet.GetName]上舰船残骸的外部分析表明它是一艘大容量运输船。该船看起来毫无活动迹象，里面也没有检测到任何生命信号。沉积物分析表明它大约已经在这里搁浅了一个世纪，对星系尺度而言这可是非常近的事情。
texts.en: External analysis of the wrecked ship on [from.Planet.GetName] suggests it is a high-capacity transporter. Its systems are inactive and unresponsive, with no  life signs detectable within. Sedimentary analysis indicates it has been here for approximately a century, which is fairly recent in the galactic timescale.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.Planet.GetName]上的坠毁舰船内部找到了复杂的水培植物生长舱和巨大的种子、土壤储存设备，还有堆满了还没派上用场的建筑材料和工具的货仓。许多数据终端上都记录着一个称为“新布拉图雅”的殖民计划。

在下层船舱内有数千个冷冻睡眠舱，里面满是这艘舰船此前居住者们的尸体。他们和我们类似，细胞生长和更新依赖光合作用。干枯的尸体说明他们是在长期的静滞睡眠中过程中死去的。
texts.en:
Inside the wrecked ship on [from.Planet.GetName], we found sophisticated chambers for hydroponic plant growth, extensive reserves of seeds and soils, and cargo bays full of untouched tools and building materials. Many of the data terminals contain plans for a new colony, designated as "New Bratulla".

On the lower decks, occupying thousands of cryosleep pods, were the dead bodies of the ship's former inhabitants. Like us, they relied on photosynthesis for cell growth and renewal. Their withered forms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

在下层船舱内有数千个冷冻睡眠舱，里面满是这艘舰船此前居住者们的尸体。干枯的尸体说明这些光合作用物种是在长期静滞睡眠的过程中死去的。
texts.en:
Inside the wrecked ship on [from.Planet.GetName], we found sophisticated chambers for hydroponic plant growth, extensive reserves of seeds and soils, and cargo bays full of untouched tools and building materials. Many of the data terminals contain plans for a new colony, designated as "New Bratulla".

On the lower decks, occupying thousands of cryosleep pods, were the dead bodies of the ship's former inhabitants. The withered forms of these phototrophic organisms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.Planet.GetName]上的殖民船残骸内发现了一处密室，里面装饰着一副反映了在一颗叫做“布拉图雅”的行星上生活风貌的绘画。有些描绘着一个郁郁葱葱的世界，而另一些则讲述着环境的衰败和大规模的死亡。最大一幅画则展示着这艘船离开荒芜的死寂废土的画面。

中央数据终端包含着一些记录着船员的影像的短片。在进行广泛的语言映射后我们得以翻译。

亚伯里西翁 —— 9721号舱

离开令人痛苦，但在新布拉图雅扎根将治愈一切。

达科特·帕安 —— 21301号舱

请相信《历代志》吧，邓德里人们。新布拉图雅将为我们带来救赎。

我们仍在搜寻这艘巨大舰船的指令舱。
texts.en:
We discovered an inner sanctum in the wrecked colony ship on [from.Planet.GetName] decorated with ornate illustrations of life on a planet called "Bratulla". Some show a lush world with thriving flora, while others detail environmental decay and mass death. The largest image depicts this vessel departing a lifeless and desolate wasteland.

A central data terminal contains short video recordings from the ship's crew. After extensive language mapping we produced translations.

Arborixxeum - Pod 9721

Leaving hurts. But putting roots on New Bratulla will heal us.

Darkht Paam - Pod 21301

Trust the chronicles, Dendritians. New Bratulla will be our salvation.

We are still searching for the command deck of this enormous vessel.

texts.zh:
在获得舰船指令面板的访问权后，我们提取并翻译出了最后一条飞行日志。

邓德鲁斯方舟一号——紧急日志——XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

恐怕我们错信了《历代志》。我们到了，但新布拉图雅，那颗天堂星球不在这里。这里不存在能够支持邓德里人生存的东西。

所有乘客的静滞睡眠都进行了延长。我们会继续搜寻……

为了从甲板上的科学终端收集这些“历代志”，我们进行了进一步的数据恢复，在其中找到了一系列不同寻常的数学证明。这些方程采用了一种奇怪的邓德里人数学形式，并假设了一颗独特的宜居行星新布拉图雅的位置。
texts.en:
After gaining access to the ship's command deck, we extracted and translated its final flight log.

ARKSHIP DENDRUS I - EMERGENCY LOG - XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

I fear our trust in the Chronicles was misplaced. We have arrived but New Bratulla, the paradise planet, is not here. Nothing here can support Dendritian life.

All passengers' stasis sleeps have been extended. We will continue our search...

Further data recovery was carried out to collect these "Chronicles" from the deck's science terminal, revealing a trove of unusual mathematical proofs. These equations employ a strange form of Dendritian mathematics and hypothesize the location of a uniquely habitable planet, New Bratulla.

title.zh: 发现退化的超空间航道

texts.zh:
《邓德里历代志》包含了一系列复杂的数学公理和抽象。这些奇怪的定理表明，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中还有一个此前尚未测绘的超空间航道，另一端正是通向新布拉图雅。

在对该区域进行广泛的量子扫描之后，我们终于找到了这个失踪的超光速的突破点，它极度靠近星系的黑洞，因此变得模糊且严重退化。修复之后，我们将会是最先发现它另一头连接着的星系的人。
texts.en:
The Dendritian Chronicles comprise a series of complex mathematical axioms and abstractions. These curious theorems suggest that the [from.solar_system.GetName] system contains one additional and previously unmapped hyperlane, leading to New Bratulla.

After extensive quantum scanning of the area we finally located the breach point for this missing hyperlane, obscured and heavily degraded due to extreme proximity to the system's black hole. By restoring it we will be the first to discover what lies beyond.

label.zh: 我们找到了邓德里人找不到的东西。
label.en: We found what the Dendritians could not.

texts.zh:
通过将能量导入[from.Planet.solar_system.GetName]内的黑洞，我们重整了其重力场，将此前遭到退化的超空间航道入口释放出来。

初步发现证实了在超空间航道的另一端存在一颗行星，这与邓德里人历代志中描述的新布拉图拉的特征一致。
texts.en:
By channeling energy into the black hole in [from.Planet.solar_system.GetName], we realigned its gravitational fields to free the previously degraded hyperlane entrance.

Initial findings confirm the existence of a single planet at the other end of the hyperlane, which aligns with the characteristics of New Bratulla as described in the Dendritian Chronicles.

label.zh: 一颗可供探索的新星球。

texts.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]上找回的残损方舟上收集有一些复杂的数学证明，被称为《历代志》。我们对其展开研究，只旨在进一步地了解邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球新布拉图雅。
texts.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on [from.Planet.GetName], we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, New Bratulla.

texts.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on [from.Planet.GetName], we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, New Bratulla.

texts.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on [from.Planet.GetName], we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, New Bratulla.

title.zh: 修复退化的超空间航道

texts.zh: 如果我们能找到修复[from.solar_system.GetName]中退化的超空间航道的方法，我们就能确认新布拉图雅，这颗邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球是否存在。
texts.en: If we can find a way to restore the degraded hyperlane in [from.solar_system.GetName], we will be able to confirm the existence of New Bratulla, the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians.
